global_style: Opulent Jazz Age glamour; sunlit pastels; diffused natural light; extreme slow-motion elegance; romantic yet bittersweet tone.

project_settings.location_lock: North Shore, Long Island, New York, USA

narrative_context.global_mood: Lavish, romantic, nostalgic; awe melting into aching melancholy.
key_events: Gatsby jubilantly tosses pastel silk and linen shirts from an upper wardrobe balcony.
Shirts drift in extreme slow-motion, billowing and settling on a massive plush bed.
Daisy laughs, then, overwhelmed, buries her face in the shirts and weeps.
A soft voiceover: "They're such beautiful shirts... I've never seen such beautiful shirts before."
narrative_context.cultural_context: American Jazz Age excess and conspicuous consumption; wealth as romantic spectacle; emotional fragility beneath opulence.

characters.name: Gatsby
characters.description: Well-groomed man in his thirties, handsome, athletic, exuding effortless wealth and polish; bright eyes, confident smile.
characters.clothing_style: Impeccable 1920s tailoring; pastel silk and linen shirts; crisp trousers; polished oxfords.
characters.voice_description: Smooth, enthusiastic, upper-class American, mid-30s; controlled yet eager.
characters.personality: Romantic, performative, idealistic, restless, desperate to impress.
characters.backstory: Extremely wealthy host who curates opulence; past feelings for Daisy fuel grand gestures.
characters.current_motivation: Dazzle Daisy with extravagant display to win her heart.

characters.name: Daisy
characters.description: Delicate, luminous woman in her twenties, refined features, gentle poise; expressive eyes brimming with conflicting feelings.
characters.clothing_style: Elegant 1920s couture; soft fabrics; understated jewelry.
characters.voice_description: Soft, breathy, refined; fragile tremor when moved to tears.
characters.backstory: A woman of privilege drawn to displays of romance yet burdened by insecurity and expectation.
characters.current_motivation: Enjoy the attention yet overwhelmed by emotion as memories and desires surface.

locations.name: Luxurious Sunlit Bedroom with Open Wardrobe
locations.visual_style: Sun-drenched, massive windows, diffused daylight; colossal open wardrobe with balcony; plush bed; pastel textiles swirling in slow-motion.
locations.narrative_function: Place of wealth display and emotional reveal.

props.name: Pastel Silk and Linen Shirts
props.visual_description: Cascade of vibrant pastel shirts—lavender, coral, apple green—silk and linen; light, airy, billowing in slow-motion.

props.name: Massive Plush Bed
props.visual_description: Oversized, sumptuous bed with thick upholstered headboard and heaps of soft bedding; shirts settle atop it.

props.name: Colossal Open Wardrobe with Balcony
props.visual_description: Two-story open wardrobe with upper balcony, gleaming shelves and rails densely packed with colorful shirts.

props.name: Massive Sunlit Windows
props.visual_description: Floor-to-ceiling windows flooding the bedroom with soft, diffused natural light; gauzy curtains lift gently.
